Class XMLDBAccessBeanInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.beans.SimpleBeanInfo
      • oracle.xml.xmldbaccess.XMLDBAccessBeanInfo
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.beans.BeanInfo

     
    public class XMLDBAccessBeanInfo
extends java.beans.SimpleBeanInfo
